in_marathi.name: Virochan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Intellectual leader, knower of truth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Virochan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Virochan is a Sanskrit name for a wise and intellectual leader. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'vi' meaning 'in the presence of' and 'rochan' meaning 'vision, knowledge'. The name signifies one who has a deep understanding of the truth and is able to guide others with his wisdom.
